key.markai.sethome: Companion: mark home (Ctrl+P applies to group)
markai.ui.title: Companion
markai.ui.taming_guide_wolf: Wolf: give a wild wolf bones. Once tamed, it appears here automatically.
markai.ui.taming_guide_chicken: Chicken: sneak (Shift), hold seeds and right-click a wild chicken.
markai.ui.taming_guide_notes: Normal seed feeding still works; Shift is required to tame.
markai.command.hint.tame: Adopt your already-tamed wolf under the crosshair. Not available for chickens.
markai.command.hint.summon: Call the same companion; this does not create a duplicate.
markai.command.hint.dismiss: Leave the companion waiting. Its identity and inventory are preserved.
markai.ui.name: Companion name
markai.ui.stale: State is outdated; waiting for server…
markai.ui.group_only: This command only supports one companion at a time.
markai.ui.start_chat: Start a conversation. Scroll to read earlier messages.
markai.ui.select_memory: Select a memory. Scroll for more entries or details. ‹ › change pages.
markai.ui.no_server: The server does not support the MarkAI interface.
markai.hub.title: My companions
markai.hub.group_command_hint: Order applies to the whole group; orders unsupported by a species are skipped.
markai.command.hint.group_modifier: Hold Ctrl while pressing this command to order all compatible companions.
markai.hub.group_wolf_only_hint: This order is supported by wolves; other species are skipped.
markai.hub.taming_hint: Wolf: bones. Chicken: sneak + right-click with seeds.
markai.hub.roster_hint: Open a personal profile, conversation or settings.
markai.hub.settings_hint: Shared preferences apply to all your companions.
markai.hub.hint.all_defense: Enable or disable owner defense for all your companions, including unloaded ones.
markai.hub.hint.all_autochat: Ambient comments use their own context and never trigger group reply loops.
markai.hub.hint.all_hud: Enable or disable the HUD for all your companions.
markai.hub.hint.all_follow_distance: Shared follow distance, from 2 to 16 blocks. Each click increases it by one.
markai.hub.chat_hint: Shared chat with your nearby companions. Address them by actual names. They retain context and may talk to one another, up to 10 companion replies total after your message.
markai.hub.hint.group_enabled: Enable this panel shared chat. Actual-name addressing works only here. Private conversations always address the selected companion.
markai.hub.hint.mutual_replies: Companions may ask each other questions by their actual names. At most 10 companion messages total after your message; they can stop earlier.
markai.talent.evasive.desc: Makes the chicken flee nearby monsters.
markai.journal.minecraft.wolf.overview: A wild pack animal that can become a loyal companion when tamed.
markai.journal.minecraft.wolf.behavior: Wolves hunt nearby sheep, rabbits and skeletons; tamed wolves defend their owner when threatened.
markai.journal.minecraft.wolf.habitat: Wolves are commonly encountered in forests, taigas and other cold or wooded biomes.
markai.journal.minecraft.wolf.threats: Untamed wolves may attack sheep and rabbits; hostile mobs can threaten a lone wolf.
markai.journal.minecraft.wolf.taming: Feed bones to a wild wolf until hearts appear. A tamed wolf can be healed with suitable meat.
markai.journal.minecraft.chicken.overvie: A small farm animal that wanders and lays eggs over time.
markai.journal.minecraft.chicken.behavio: Chickens wander, follow seeds and may drop feathers or raw chicken when killed.
markai.journal.minecraft.chicken.habitat: Chickens commonly appear in grassy biomes where animals can spawn.
markai.journal.minecraft.chicken.threats: Chickens are vulnerable to hostile mobs and fall damage.
markai.journal.minecraft.chicken.taming: Hold seeds and use them to breed chickens; vanilla chickens cannot be tamed.
markai.journal.minecraft.zombie.overview: A hostile undead mob that attacks nearby players and villagers.
markai.journal.minecraft.zombie.behavior: Zombies pursue targets, burn in direct sunlight and may call nearby zombies for help.
markai.journal.minecraft.zombie.habitat: Zombies commonly appear in darkness and underground areas; they can also spawn during raids or events.
markai.journal.minecraft.zombie.threats: Zombies deal melee damage and can overwhelm players in groups; sunlight burns ordinary zombies.
markai.journal.minecraft.zombie.taming: Zombies cannot be tamed in vanilla survival. Use light, distance or defensive barriers.
markai.journal.empty: No creatures documented yet. Explore nearby wildlife.
markai.journal.no_notes: No personal notes for this species.
